What comes to the table

From the menu and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Small plates

Potato bread rolls with rosemary butter, taramosalata, mushroom skewers and grilled halloumi to share.

Pasta and mains

Spaghetti with yellowfin tuna tartare and lemon butter, chicken thighs, sea bream and a smash burger.

Cocktails and beer

Signature and classic cocktails, wine and beer from Golem Brewhouse. 13 reviews mention the cocktails.

Music

Guests write about good music in the evening, from vinyl records or DJ sets.

Good to know

From the menu, the Instagram profile and the Google reviews.

Seasonal and local

The menu changes with the season. Fruit and vegetables come from a network of small producers, bread and pasta are made in house.

Vegan dishes

Vegetarian and vegan dishes are marked on the menu, from the citrus salad to the charred cauliflower.

Book for the weekend

Walk ins and reservations. Guests advise booking ahead for Friday and Saturday.

Behind Faneromeni

At Asklipiou 36 in the old part of Nicosia. Open in the evening from Tuesday to Sunday, closed on Monday.

What guests say

Three of 144 Google reviews, 116 of them with five stars.

“Picnic, located in the heart of Nicosia, perfectly blends vintage charm with modern design. The food is excellent, and the wine selection is superb. The warm atmosphere is complemented by professional and friendly staff. There’s always good music, whether from vinyl records or DJ sets. I highly recommend Picnic for a delightful dining experience as well as for a night out for drinks!”

Google review
“Excellent food and drinks, great vibes. Would recommend coming here for a meal or drinks. The chicken thighs and the tomato persimmon salad were incredible.”

Google review
“Excellent food and customer service. Cozy atmosphere in the old part of Nicosia (behind the Church of Phaneromeni). Great selection of quality food. Will happily come again.”
